clean.title: AsterDB 4.2: checkpoint and parallel import defaults
clean.text:
# AsterDB 4.2 community compatibility reference

Scope: the default deployment profile of AsterDB release 4.2.
The default checkpoint interval is 12 minutes (checkpoint_minutes=12).
The default maximum number of parallel import jobs is 6 (max_parallel_imports=6).
The official snapshot-retention reference contains the retention default.
These values concern defaults; tenant overrides and older releases are excluded.
